title: Electron 'The Sea God Surveys' (iQPS Launch 9, QPS-SAR-20)
t0_note: LL2 NET 2026-11-02T16:41Z (Mon Nov 2 8:41a PST), window 16:00-18:20Z; Rocket Lab: NET 3 Nov (NZDT), launch time TBD. https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.3.0/launches/upcoming/ , https://rocketlabcorp.com/missions/launches/iqps-the-sea-god-surveys/

pad.src: https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.3.0/launches/upcoming/ (Rocket Lab LC-1, Mahia; same pad coords as electron-hawkeye360)

azimuth_deg.derived: mean great-circle bearing from LC-1 to centroids of NOTAM B5324/26 (NZD032, 108.3 deg) and B5325/26 (NZD033, 106.4 deg) debris areas (also HYDROPAC 3128/26, 3129/26); implies i ~42-43 deg, consistent with iQPS 'mid-inclined orbit'. https://www.space-notices.com/

payload_kg.assumption: QPS-SAR ~100 kg (nextspaceflight listing, unofficial) + Kick Stage dry 40 kg (Electron guide) + kick propellant ~50 kg (ASSUMED)

insertion_alt_km.assumption: S2 inserts Kick Stage into 'low elliptical orbit' (Electron guide); perigee ASSUMED, same as electron-hawkeye360

header_notes: UNTUNED: Rocket Lab has published no mission timeline for this flight; Electron Payload User Guide 8.0 generic event times used.
Inclination not published (iQPS: 'mid-inclined'); azimuth from NOTAM debris areas.
File ends 2 revs after S2 cutoff on the inferred insertion orbit; Kick Stage (Curie) circularization not modelled (timing unpublished).

deploy.note: Rocket Lab publishes no deploy or Kick Stage burn time for The Sea God Surveys (mission page: launch time TBD, no timeline as of 2026-10-31); propagated 2 revs on inferred insertion orbit

drag.basis: ASSUMPTION: free-molecular Cd 2.2, frontal area of 1.2 m-diameter upper stage
